"Between 3400 and 3000 BCE the number of monuments and the number of axes/celts (Z-scores of MonumentCount and AxesCelts) rose together into a sharp mid-window peak around 3200 BCE and then fell back, ending the window slightly above their starting values (monuments: −0.46 at 3400 → peak +0.91 at 3200 → −0.36 at 3000, net +0.10; axes: 0.37 → peak +2.60 at 3200 → 0.80 at 3000, net +0.43; monuments–axes correlation r ≈ +0.87).
